review_text: Rove Downtown was exceptionally clean with direct Burj Khalifa views from the pool deck. Metro shuttle made traveling so convenient.
Emirates non-stop from Kolkata to Dubai was flawless. Generous 30kg baggage allowed ample shopping at Dubai Mall.
The Red Dunes Desert Safari in Lahbab was thrilling! The dune bashing sandboarding and barbecue under stars was unforgettable.
Viewing Dubai from 124th floor at sunset took my breath away. Booked via TravelMate AI seamlessly.
Address Downtown provided world-class hospitality and the private pedestrian bridge to Dubai Mall saved so much time.
The Abu Dhabi Grand Mosque is majestic beyond words. The white marble courtyards and floral inlays are stunning.
IndiGo connection via Mumbai was on schedule. Value for money was unbeatable.
Marina Byblos was very close to DMCC metro station and JBR beach. Great English pub downstairs.
Museum of the Future looks like a spaceship from 2071! The interactive DNA vault is a must-see.
Atlantis Palm Aquaventure was pure fun for the entire family. Feeding stingrays was a highlight!
